lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Eric Ruiz is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Eric is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ Eric Ruiz is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Eric kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Eric's gone." Maya looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Eric." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Esther blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Debris Shelter (Level 1). A lean-to of branches and leaves beats nothing. Dead air is insulation.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Cordage (Level 1). Twist plant fibers into string. Dogbane, nettle, yucca — strong fibers are everywhere.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Eric Ruiz, 41 days. The mantle passes to Esther Cui.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Esther Cui, 62 — a trail crew lead. Her hands know different work now: Night Eyes, Echo Location.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Eric — and Eric is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Claire, Fati, Célia and 6 more speak for Esther — "Eric trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Esther before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
